Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding judicial application of equitable principles in land use cases.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a court's application of equitable principles inland use cases; and adding a new section to chapter 36.70C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An applicant for a land use permit or approval who proceeds withconstruction after the permit or approval has been challenged under RCW36.70C.040, but before a court has made a decision under RCW36.70C.140, does so at the applicant's own risk. A court is notrequired to apply the common law doctrine of balancing the equities ifdoing so would reward a land use applicant for proceeding under anunlawful land use decision.
